Following the [[Caamas Firestorm]], an '''[[Ithorian Herdship|Ithorian herdship]]''' crashed under mysterious circumstances on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The shattered remains of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] were left on [[Caamas's smallest landmass]] in the southern hemisphere of the planet, which allowed the alien [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] contained within to take root there and become the first example of [[Plant/Legends|vegetation]] on the surface since the devastation of Caamas. Only a few [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]] knew about the existence of the herdship.<ref name="CATCW" />
